name: Magson Retail and Distribution Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2018, Magson Retail and Distribution Ltd is in the business of retail trade through a chain of stores[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
MRDL is in the Retail and Distribution business of gourmet, frozen food and speciality foods. It operates retail outlets across its portfolio of brands.

pros: Promoter holding has increased by 1.22% over last quarter.
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 12.0% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.93 Cr.
